item.title: The Trump administration's move to end subsidies for Medicare drug plans could cost consumers
item.description: Federal subsidies that have helped defray insurers' Medicare drug costs will disappear at the end of the year. Millions of beneficiaries could face higher premiums in 2027.

item.title: Oregon is on track for its worst wildfire season yet
item.description: Wildfires in central and eastern Oregon are prompting evacuations and forcing ranchers to scramble to move cattle and find feed as public range land burns. More than a million acres have burned so far. Most fires have little or no containment.

item.title: 'Taiwan Travelogue' rethinks history, colonialism, and identity
item.description: The author and translator of Taiwan Travelogue, the winner of the 2026 International Booker Prize, discuss identity and history amid the debate over Taiwan's colonial ties to Japan and escalating geopolitical pressure from China.

item.title: 'Odyssey' translator Emily Wilson says Nolan shouldn't have written the movie himself
item.description: The renowned classics scholar caused a stir when her critical review of Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey went viral. Wilson explains her reaction to the film and why she's translating the poem again.
item.content:encoded:
The Odyssey in the London Review of Books. Wilson has loved Greek myths since childhood and has translated both the Iliad and Odyssey. She has tattoos of a spear on one leg and a bow on the other — she says they represent Achilles and Odysseus.'/>

item.title: 'Machines are collaborators' at this new museum of AI art
item.description: "What is beyond reality?" asks artist Refik Anadol. His latest projects include Dataland, an immersive AI art museum in Los Angeles, and an installation at the Smithsonian in Washington, D.C.

item.title: To win over working-class voters, Democrats need to stop talking about democracy
item.description: Working-class voters have moved away from the Democratic Party. Winning them back is key to the party's future, a new reports shows. But first, the messaging has to change.
